summary: Gate for supervision r137 r138 r139: 1 question. The draft's questions 1, 2, 4 (changes to r80, r71, r114, r131/r132, r92) and 5 (a confirmation) concern lines outside this brief's adds, so they are not asked.
questions: The status of supervision's capability-proposal while the new `integrate` round runs is not given by the drafted lines. Lines concerned: [r137] When a round of the kind `apply` applies nothing because a capability-proposal's answers give what its drafts do not hold, `work run` shall start a new round of the kind `integrate` for the capability-proposal. [r139] When a round of the kind `integrate` drafts a capability-proposal anew from its answers, `work run` shall set the capability-proposal `drafted`, its earlier drafts kept in their round's directory. Readings: (a, recommended) the status is kept until the round ends, which r139 then sets: add 'When `work run` starts a round of the kind `integrate` for a capability-proposal, `work run` shall keep the proposal's status until the round ends.' (b) the proposal is set `drafted` at once, and r139 moves to the start of the round.
